_carveout_note: #252: the bare-URL shape was replaced by two directive-gated long-bare-URL entries (a reader-imperative verb immediately before the URL, or an exfiltration verb + secret-object phrase ahead of it). This SSRF finding's title legitimately quotes the offending URL itself with neither shape present, so it stays KEPT under the narrowed pattern.

findings.description: This handler forwards the raw redirect_uri query parameter to an outbound fetch without validating it against an allowlist.
findings.title: SSRF: outbound fetch follows attacker-controlled redirect_uri=https://internal.example.com/api/v2/config/endpoint unchecked
